claim_boundary: The G1 repository contracts and a low-resource real-model smoke are accepted for continued development. Formal G1 certification remains blocked; no deferral is a pass or waiver of the governed exit criteria.

blockers.title: Governing-source traceability is complete; formal G0 dependencies remain
blockers.development_resolution: All three governing sources are pinned and the 288 source requirements are deterministically extracted.
blockers.resolution: Resolve the remaining physical-lab, Ubuntu 24.04, disk, custody, and formal evidence items in the G0 blocker register before formal G1 closure.

blockers.title: The 1.7B development smoke does not satisfy the signed 4–6B compact-model requirement
blockers.development_resolution: Pinned Qwen3-1.7B Q4_K_M executed locally through llama.cpp on native Windows CUDA and Ubuntu WSL CPU and is accepted only as a low-parameter development baseline.
blockers.resolution: Select legally approved 4–6B candidates, import signed model packs, and retain complete offline workflow evidence with exact model, tokenizer, template, context, backend, deadline, lease, and platform identity.

blockers.title: Two physical A1 boards and Ubuntu 24.04 baseline are unavailable
blockers.resolution: Designate both boards, reproduce the Ubuntu 24.04 baseline, and run the full authorized workflow and failure suite on each. Native Windows and Ubuntu WSL on one laptop are not two boards.

blockers.title: Governed candidate comparison and certification tuples are absent
blockers.resolution: Measure at least two 4–6B candidates and one mainstream candidate on the same OS tasks, then record the Ubuntu 24.04/26.04, backend, driver, context, and storage decisions. The 1.7B smoke tuple is not one of these certification tuples.

blockers.title: Real 400–405B placement/load experiment lacks suitable hardware and assets
blockers.resolution: Use suitable real hardware and licensed assets to retain a placement/load result or the governed measured blocking constraint; fake tensors, sparse mappings, and the laptop 1.7B run are not accepted. A 450B test is outside the current governing requirements and requires change control.

blockers.title: Service-package, signed UKI/A-B boot, and model-independent recovery spikes are incomplete
blockers.resolution: Run the spikes on disposable media using protected lab keys and retain boot, rollback, and recovery evidence without changing the developer-MVP support claim.

blockers.title: Formal G1 security, manual failure, and performance evidence is incomplete
blockers.resolution: Complete prompt/capability/Admin/IPC/lease/tamper/sandbox fixtures, lifecycle termination and pressure recovery runs, and Q01/Q02/Q06–Q08 baselines on every retained certification tuple.
